note: The seven Legendaries, one of one, one per home, in the waves' order: each a piece no other gnome wears and that moves (web/lib/scene/gnome-legend.ts), a material or hat of his own, and a trail and a holing that only he has. kind is his number (1-7) in the traits.

legendaries.name: Windmill King
legendaries.concept: The garden's mill made king: his hat is the mill, a gold crown round its foot, its four sails turning.
legendaries.line: The mill by hole 4 crowned him. The wind does what he says, mostly.
legendaries.lore: Garden 4's mill turned for a hundred summers before a gnome climbed in. He came out with the sails on his head and a crown he did not ask for. The wind has followed him round the course ever since: it blows petals after him, and on the green it holds its breath.

legendaries.name: The Admiral
legendaries.concept: The Island Cup's admiral: a golden tricorn, gold epaulettes, a navy coat, a pennant flying.
legendaries.line: Commands the island's fleet: one boat and a rubber duck.
legendaries.lore: Nobody gave him the rank. He found the hat on the beach and the coat in a sea chest, and the island agreed it suited him. He rolls in leaving a wake of foam, and every cup he sinks sends up a splash, as a ship's should.

legendaries.name: Ancient Mushroom
legendaries.concept: Mushroom Town's oldest resident: a great cap for a hat, its spots glowing and breathing, small mushrooms grown on it, spores in the air.
legendaries.line: Was here before the town. The town grew round him.
legendaries.lore: Mushroom Town's houses are his cousins, and he is older than all of them. His cap glows when he is thinking, which is slowly. Where he rolls, spores drift; where he holes, a ring of new mushrooms will be up by morning.

legendaries.name: Summit Gnome
legendaries.concept: The Mountain Cup's summit made gnome: frost over all of him, a cap of snow on his hat, icicles from its brim.
legendaries.line: Came down from the top for one round. Has not warmed up since.
legendaries.lore: He lives where the course's last green is, above the snow line, and comes down only to play. Frost grows on him as he rolls; behind him it snows a little; and the cup that takes him gets a small avalanche over its rim.

legendaries.name: Crystal Gnome
legendaries.concept: The Crystal Mines' heart: a faceted, see-through body that catches the light, shards grown from his hat, a core that glints.
legendaries.line: Grew in the dark for a thousand years. Came up for the golf.
legendaries.lore: The miners found him in the Geode's last ring, humming the same note as the singing crystals. He is see-through, but you can never quite see through him. He drops shards where he rolls and the cup rings like a struck glass when he holes.

legendaries.name: Lava Gnome
legendaries.concept: The volcano's own: a dark crust split by glowing cracks that pulse, a little vent smoking on his hat.
legendaries.line: Rolled out of the volcano one morning. Still cooling.
legendaries.lore: The volcano on the Island Cup's last holes coughed him up, warm, on a quiet morning. His cracks glow when he breathes, his hat smokes when he thinks, and embers follow him down the fairway. Do not hand him the flag.

legendaries.name: Storm Gnome
legendaries.concept: The storm's own gnome: a little thundercloud over his hat, raining, flashing now and then.
legendaries.line: Carries the weather with him. The cup gets the lightning.
legendaries.lore: Every storm on the Island Cup was his, once. Now it is just the one cloud, small and loyal, that rains on him and nobody else. Gusts streak behind him as he rolls, and when he holes, the cloud lets go its bolt.
